Casting the sum to BIGINT preserves COUNT(*)'s DuckDB type; NULL timestamps retain their NULL hour group.","sql":"SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Use a partitioned window count followed by DISTINCT to produce one row per hour, preserving duplicate counts, the NULL hour group, and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Move the unchanged calendar-day predicate into a filtered aggregate and discard groups with no qualifying rows. This preserves route NULLs, qualifying duplicate counts, and BIGINT counts without imposing a date range.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filter with the original predicate, calculate route counts using a window, then deduplicate the output. NULL route keys remain grouped together, and COUNT(*) retains its BIGINT type.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"}]}
